events.title: German-facing eMMC recall notice

geography.evidence: Manufacturer German support FAQ; dated reporting describes German owner emails and absent KBA listing at that time, not a confirmed regulator action date.

events.date_basis: Current official FAQ is undated; US/China notice dates and January 22 global software-uptake observation are not German notice/remedy starts.
events.description: Software mitigation plus physical memory replacement. Source says owners await parts; no dated German completion or delivery blockage.
conflicts: February 2021 report: some German owners received emails, others did not; KBA entry not found then. Not a timeless proof of no recall.
Primary FAQ predominantly says 64GB replacement but another answer says 64MB; ledger records remedy category, not asserted replacement capacity.
events.rationale: Retain uncertainty/exclusion; do not turn this into a verified monthly exposure.

recall.affected_models_and_years: Model S and Model X built before March 2018 with specified 8GB eMMC MCU; not all such vehicles necessarily still affected.
recall.defect_period_description: Manufacture eligibility before March 2018; actual defect-occurrence interval unspecified.
